series.name: P-family protection codes (P0, P5–P8, PA/PC/PH/PL/PU/PP)
series.notes: P-family electrical/drive protections from PK tables. almumtaz P0/P1/P2 mapping quarantined.

meaning.en: Power/drive module fails to leave reset or faults during initialization.
meaning.ur: Power/drive module reset se bahar nahi nikal raha ya shuruat ke waqt fault kar raha hai.

causes.ur: Supply ya board ka masla hai

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker for 2 minutes and switch on once so the module can leave reset
solutions.ur: Breaker par power 2 minute band karein aur ek dafa on karein taake module reset se bahar aaye

solutions.en: If the code stays, a technician checks the supply to the board and replaces the drive module
solutions.ur: Code rahe to technician board ki supply check kare aur drive module badle

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK + acguide.pk

notes.ur: Is code ka source multi-pk hai.

meaning.en: Excessive current in one compressor phase → shutdown.
meaning.ur: Compressor ke kisi ek phase mein zyada current one ki wajah se unit band ho gaya.

causes.ur: Supply unstable hai / wiring mein masla hai

solutions.en: Switch off and check the mains supply and wiring before any further start attempt
solutions.ur: Band karke aur kisi bhi dobara start se pehle mains supply aur wiring check karein

solutions.en: A technician measures compressor current on each phase and the protection sensor, then replaces the faulty part
solutions.ur: Technician har phase par compressor current aur protection sensor naape, phir kharab part badle

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK + acguide.pk

notes.en: Maqsood: sudden shutdown, breaker trip, buzzing possible. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + maqsood.
notes.ur: Maqsood: achanak band hona, breaker trip, buzzing aa sakti hai. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + maqsood.

title.en: Main board ↔ drive board communication error
title.ur: Main board aur drive board ka rabta (communication) kharab

meaning.en: Serial link between main control and drive board failed.
meaning.ur: Main control board aur drive board ke darmiyan serial link kharab ho gaya.

causes.ur: Harness dhili ya ghalat lagi hui hai
Dono taraf ka board kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and reseat the serial harness between the main control and the drive board
solutions.ur: Power band karke main control aur drive board ke darmiyan serial harness dobara lagayein

solutions.en: A technician tests the link and replaces the faulty board at either end
solutions.ur: Technician link test kare aur dono taraf ka kharab board badle

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK + acguide.pk

notes.ur: Is code ki attribution multi-pk hai.

title.ur: IPM temperature sensor circuit ki kharabi

meaning.en: Sensor reading IPM temperature is open/short/implausible.
meaning.ur: IPM temperature sensor ki reading khul, short ya qabil-e-taweeq hai.

causes.ur: Sensor fail ho gaya ya connection theek nahi hai

solutions.en: Disconnect power and check the IPM temperature-sensor connector and wiring
solutions.ur: Power disconnect karke IPM temperature sensor ka connector aur wiring check karein

solutions.en: A technician tests the sensor, then replaces the sensor, IPM, or board as the tests indicate
solutions.ur: Technician sensor test kare, phir test ke mutabiq sensor, IPM ya board badle

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK + acguide.pk

notes.en: acguide wording “OFC IC” likely typo/variant of IPM/PFC sensor context. Per-code attribution: multi-pk (acguide: “OFC IC temperature sensor” variant).
notes.ur: acguide ka OFC IC lafz shayad typo hai ya IPM/PFC sensor context ka variant. Per-code attribution: multi-pk (acguide: OFC IC temperature sensor variant).

meaning.en: IPM exceeded safe temperature; drive derates or stops.
meaning.ur: IPM ka temperature had se zyada ho gaya; drive frequency kam karta hai ya ruk jata hai.

causes.ur: IPM par zyada load / kam cooling

solutions.en: Power off and let the outdoor unit cool; clear anything blocking airflow around it
solutions.ur: Power band karke outdoor unit ko thanda hone dein; aas paas airflow rukne wali cheezein hatayein

solutions.en: Restart after cooldown and have the technician replace the IPM if overheating returns
solutions.ur: Thanda hone ke baad restart karein aur overheat wapas aaye to technician IPM badle

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK + acguide.pk

notes.ur: Is code ke sources multi-pk hain.

title.ur: Input AC side par overcurrent protection

meaning.en: Excessive AC current drawn from input side triggered protection.
meaning.ur: Input side se zyada AC current kheenchte hi hifazat chali.

causes.ur: Upar wala component fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Disconnect supply and inspect incoming wiring and components for shorts before resetting
solutions.ur: Supply disconnect karke reset se pehle aane wali wiring aur components ko short ke liye check karein

solutions.en: A technician repairs the identified fault, then verifies normal current draw
solutions.ur: Technician pakda gaya fault repair kare, phir normal current draw verify kare

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK + acguide.pk

notes.ur: Is code ki attribution multi-pk aur acguide hai.

title.ur: Current detection circuit / sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: Current sensing path (sensor or circuit) gave invalid readings.
meaning.ur: Current sensing path (sensor ya circuit) ne ghalat reading de di.

solutions.en: Power off and check the current-sensor connector and circuitry for visible damage
solutions.ur: Power band kar ke current-sensor connector aur circuitry ko ghoor kar dekhein — koi nazar aane wala nuqsan nahi hona chahiye.

solutions.en: A technician tests the sensor and repairs the detection circuit or replaces the sensor
solutions.ur: Technician sensor test kare aur detection circuit repair kare ya sensor badle

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK + acguide.pk

notes.ur: Is code ke sources multi-pk hain (per-code attribution).

title.ur: DC bus high voltage ki hifazat

meaning.en: PN/DC-bus voltage above safe maximum (often supply surge or regenerative overvoltage).
meaning.ur: PN/DC bus ki voltage had se zyada ho gayi (aam taur par supply surge ya regenerative overvoltage).

causes.ur: Utility ki overvoltage / stabilizer fail ho gaya
Voltage regulation ke parts kharab hain

solutions.en: Disconnect the unit and measure mains voltage with a meter before any probe
solutions.ur: Unit disconnect karke kisi bhi probe se pehle meter se mains voltage naapein

solutions.en: A technician checks the stabilizer and voltage-regulation parts and replaces the faulty ones
solutions.ur: Technician stabilizer aur voltage-regulation parts check kare aur kharab parts badle

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK + acguide.pk

notes.en: Maqsood: unit may fail to start or shut down unexpectedly. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + maqsood.
notes.ur: Maqsood: unit start na ho ya achanak band ho jaye. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + maqsood.

title.ur: DC bus low voltage ki hifazat

meaning.en: DC-bus/PN voltage below minimum — often sagging supply or unstable mains.
meaning.ur: DC bus/PN ki voltage minimum se neeche ho gayi — aam taur par supply girne ya mains be-qarar hone ki wajah se.

causes.en: Unstable/low mains (very common PK complaint with unstable supply)
causes.ur: Mains unstable ya kam hain (PK mein unstable supply ki shikayat bohot common hai)

solutions.en: Check stabilizer output under load; fix supply
solutions.ur: Load par stabilizer ka output check karein; supply theek karwayein

solutions.en: Technician: inspect bus capacitors/regulation
solutions.ur: Technician bus capacitors aur regulation inspect kare

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK + acguide.pk

notes.ur: Is code ke sources multi-pk aur maqsood hain.

meaning.en: Soft-start/charging circuit failed to charge the DC bus capacitor properly.
meaning.ur: Soft-start/charging circuit DC bus capacitor ko theek se charge nahi kar paya.

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the board before checking the charging circuit
solutions.ur: Power band karke charging circuit check se pehle board isolate karein

solutions.en: A technician tests the charging resistor, relay, and capacitor and replaces the failed part or board
solutions.ur: Technician charging resistor, relay aur capacitor test kare aur kharab part ya board badle

source.title: AYS Online PK + Japan Electronics PK + Electra Fix PK + acguide.pk

notes.ur: Is code ka source multi-pk aur acguide hai.

meaning.ur: Incoming AC voltage acceptable range se bahar hai (be-qarar ya surge ke saath).

solutions.en: Measure incoming mains with a meter and compare it against the unit rated supply
solutions.ur: Meter se incoming mains naapein aur unit ke rated supply se compare karein

solutions.en: Fit the correct stabilizer, or call an electrician if the supply stays unstable
solutions.ur: Sahi stabilizer lagayein, ya supply unstable rahe to electrician bulayein
